units.source_text: 陶渊明《归去来兮辞》中说：“三径就荒，松菊犹存。”

en.t: In Tao Yuanming's Return Home, he says, "The three paths have fallen into neglect, yet the pines and chrysanthemums still remain."

units.source_text: 三径指通门、通井、通厕的径。

en.t: The three paths refer to the paths leading to the gate, the well, and the privy.
